lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਰਮ ਜਿ ਪੂਰਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahamanah sa(n)g udharana(n) braham karam j pooranah ||
lines.translation: Associating with the Brahmin, one is saved, if his actions are perfect and God-like.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਤੰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਗਹੰ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਫਲਹ ॥੬੫॥
lines.transliteration: aatam rata(n) sa(n)saar gaha(n) te nar naanak nihaphalah ||65||
lines.translation: Those whose souls are imbued with the world - O Nanak, their lives are fruitless. ||65||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਹਿਰਣੰ ਬਹੁ ਵਿਘਨ ਕਰਣੰ ਉਚਰਣੰ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਕਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: par darab hirana(n) bahu vighan karana(n) ucharana(n) sarab jee kah ||
lines.translation: The mortal steals the wealth of others, and makes all sorts of problems; his preaching is only for his own livelihood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਉ ਲਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਤਿਪਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਏ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਸਿ ਸੂਕਰਹ ॥੬੬॥
lines.transliteration: lau laee trisanaa atipat man maae karam karat s sookarah ||66||
lines.translation: His desire for this and that is not satisfied; his mind is caught in Maya, and he is acting like a pig. ||66||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤੇ ਸਮੇਵ ਚਰਣੰ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਭੈ ਦੁਤਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: mate samev charana(n) udharana(n) bhai dutarah ||
lines.translation: Those who are intoxicated and absorbed in the Lord's Lotus Feet are saved from the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਹਰਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਨ ਸੰਸਯਹ ॥੬੭॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: anek paatik harana(n) naanak saadh sa(n)gam na sa(n)sayah ||67||4||
lines.translation: Countless sins are destroyed, O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; there is no doubt about this. ||67||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਗਾਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 5 gaathaa ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl, Gaat'haa:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਪੂਰ ਪੁਹਪ ਸੁਗੰਧਾ ਪਰਸ ਮਾਨੁਖੵ ਦੇਹੰ ਮਲੀਣੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: karapoor puhap suga(n)dhaa paras maanukhy deha(n) maleena(n) ||
lines.translation: Camphor, flowers and perfume become contaminated, by coming into contact with the human body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਜਾ ਰੁਧਿਰ ਦ੍ਰੁਗੰਧਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਥਿ ਗਰਬੇਣ ਅਗੵਾਨਣੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: majaa rudhir druga(n)dhaa naanak ath garaben agyaanano ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the ignorant one is proud of his foul-smelling marrow, blood and bones. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮਾਣੋ ਪਰਜੰਤ ਆਕਾਸਹ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਸਿਖੰਡਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: paramaano paraja(n)t aakaasah deep lo sikha(n)danah ||
lines.translation: Even if the mortal could reduce himself to the size of an atom, and shoot through the ethers,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਛੇਣ ਨੈਣ ਭਾਰੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਨ ਸਿਧੵਤੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gachhen nain bhaaren naanak binaa saadhoo na sidhyte ||2||
lines.translation: Worlds and realms in the blink of an eye, O Nanak, without the Holy Saint, he shall not be saved. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੋ ਸਤਿ ਹੋਵੰਤੋ ਮਰਣੋ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਣ ਮਿਥਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaano sat hova(n)to marano drisaten mithiaa ||
lines.translation: Know for sure that death will come; whatever is seen is false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਚਲੰਥੋ ਭਣੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: keerat saath chala(n)tho bhana(n)t naanak saadh sa(n)gen ||3||
lines.translation: So chant the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; this alone shall go along with you in the end. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਯਾ ਚਿਤ ਭਰਮੇਣ ਇਸਟ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੇਖੁ ਬਾਂਧਵਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: maayaa chit bharamen isat mitrekh baa(n)dhavah ||
lines.translation: The consciousness wanders lost in Maya, attached to friends and relatives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਬਧੵੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਅਸਥਾਨੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਭਜਣੰ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: labadhy(n) saadh sa(n)gen naanak sukh asathaana(n) gopaal bhajana(n) ||4||
lines.translation: Vibrating and meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, O Nanak, the eternal place of rest is found. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾਗਰ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਿੰਮੁ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਿ ਚੰਦਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: mailaagar sa(n)gen ni(n)m birakh s cha(n)danah ||
lines.translation: The lowly nim tree, growing near the sandalwood tree, becomes just like the sandalwood tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸੰਤੋ ਬਾਂਸੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਹੰ ਬੁਧਿ ਨ ਬੋਹਤੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: nikat basa(n)to baa(n)so naanak aha(n) budh na bohate ||5||
lines.translation: But the bamboo tree, also growing near it, does not pick up its fragrance; it is too tall and proud. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਥਾ ਗੁੰਫ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕਥੰ ਮਥੰ ਮਾਨ ਮਰਦਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaathaa gu(n)ph gopaal katha(n) matha(n) maan maradanah ||
lines.translation: In this Gaat'haa, the Lord's Sermon is woven; listening to it, pride is crushed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਤੰ ਪੰਚ ਸਤ੍ਰੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਣਹ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: hata(n) pa(n)ch satren naanak har baane prahaaranah ||6||
lines.translation: The five enemies are killed, O Nanak, by shooting the Arrow of the Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੁਖ ਪੰਥਾ ਲਹੰਥਾ ਬਡ ਕਰਮਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bachan saadh sukh pa(n)thaa laha(n)thaa bad karamanah ||
lines.translation: The Words of the Holy are the path of peace. They are obtained by good karma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹੰਤਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੇਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: raha(n)taa janam maranen ramana(n) naanak har keeratanah ||7||
lines.translation: The cycle of birth and death is ended, O Nanak, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤ੍ਰ ਭੁਰਿਜੇਣ ਝੜੀਯੰ ਨਹ ਜੜੀਅੰ ਪੇਡ ਸੰਪਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: patr bhurijen jhaReeya(n) nah jaReea(n) ped sa(n)pataa ||
lines.translation: When the leaves wither and fall, they cannot be attached to the branch again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣ ਬਿਖਮਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੰਤਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਬਾਸਰੋ ਰੈਣੀ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naam bihoon bikhamataa naanak baha(n)t jon baasaro rainee ||8||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, there is misery and suffering. The mortal wanders in reincarnation day and night. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਲਭੰਤੰ ਬਡ ਭਾਗਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaavanee saadh sa(n)gen labha(n)ta(n) bad bhaaganah ||
lines.translation: One is blessed with love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, by great good fortune.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਹ ਬਿਆਪਣਹ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: har naam gun ramana(n) naanak sa(n)saar saagar nah biaapanah ||9||
lines.translation: Whoever sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O Nanak, is not affected by the world-ocean. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਥਾ ਗੂੜ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਸਮਝਣੰ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਜਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaathaa gooR apaara(n) samajhana(n) biralaa janah ||
lines.translation: This Gaat'haa is profound and infinite; how rare are those who understand it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕਾਮ ਤਜਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar kaam tajana(n) naanak gobi(n)d ramana(n) saadh sa(n)gamah ||10||
lines.translation: They forsake sexual desire and worldly love, O Nanak, and praise the Lord in the Saadh Sangat. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: suma(n)tr saadh bachanaa kot dokh binaasanah ||
lines.translation: The Words of the Holy are the most sublime Mantra. They eradicate millions of sinful mistakes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਧੵਾਨੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਾਰਣਹ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: har charan kamal dhyaana(n) naanak kul samooh udhaaranah ||11||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Lord, O Nanak, all one's generations are saved. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੈਣਹ ਜੇਣ ਮਧੵ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar ma(n)dar sainah jen madhy har keeratanah ||
lines.translation: That palace is beautiful, in which the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਰਮਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧੵੰ ਬਡ ਭਾਗਣਹ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: mukate raman gobi(n)dah naanak labadhy(n) bad bhaaganah ||12||
lines.translation: Those who dwell on the Lord of the Universe are liberated. O Nanak, only the most fortunate are so blessed. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਲਬਧੋ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਮਿਤੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: har labadho mitr sumito ||
lines.translation: I have found the Lord, my Friend, my very Best Friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਦਾਰਣ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚਿਤੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: bidaaran kade na chito ||
lines.translation: He shall never break my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅਸਥਲੁ ਤੋਲੁ ਅਮਿਤੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa asathal tol amito ||
lines.translation: His dwelling is eternal; His weight cannot be weighed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋੁਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਖਾ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਤੋ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: souee naanak sakhaa jee sa(n)g kito ||13||
lines.translation: Nanak has made Him the Friend of his soul. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਜਸੰ ਮਿਟੰਤ ਸਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਹ ॥ ਸਿਮਰਤਬੵ ਰਿਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: apajasa(n) mita(n)t sat putrah || simarataby ridai gur ma(n)tranah ||
lines.translation: One's bad reputation is erased by a true son, Who meditates in his heart on the Guru's Mantra.
